name: STORM R1 clincher

origin.basis: ARISUN is a ZC Rubber (Zhongce, maker of Chaoyang) bicycle-tire brand; the official listing gives the brand as 朝阳 and the item code 艾瑞森H-908.

manufacturing.basis: The listing does not state the factory location.

positioning: ZC Rubber's lightweight 330 TPI folding race clincher, sold in China as a lower-priced alternative to premium race tires.
weight_basis: One owner weighed a 28C clincher at 221 g; the official listing gives 215 g without a size.

wet_notes.summary: One commenter found it better than a GP5000 in the wet after two months; two others said it turns very slippery once wet. The post covers both the clincher and the tubeless version.

community.summary: Ranked fastest-feeling of five budget tires but last for puncture resistance and mid-pack for grip.
Light and lively for 3,000 km; a bulge formed at a puncture site, and commenters reported sidewall cord cracks at 100-1,000 km.
A creator test presents it as a GP5000 alternative; commenters reported early cracks and bulges, some replaced under warranty.
Owner-measured 221 g at 28C; commenters praise speed and feel but report fast wear.
Owner: more dry grip and high-speed stability than a Michelin Power Cup, comfortable, close to 28 mm on a 19 mm rim; not yet ridden in the wet.
A 28C rear wore through to the casing after about 1,800 km; other owners report 7,000-10,000 km.
Commenters on a tubeless-bulge post: one clincher sidewall cracked through at about 1,000 km; another lasted 7,000 km with several punctures; others had no problem at 1,000-2,000 km.
About 10,000 km to the casing for a light rider with about five punctures; the post does not say clincher or tubeless.

availability.note: Sold in mainland China through an official Tmall store; no European or North American seller was verified.

price_observations.conditions: Tmall list price before discounts ('优惠前') on 2026-11-01; the listing does not say whether the option is one tire or a pair.

caveats: Several owners report bulges, sidewall cracks or wear-through within 1,000-2,000 km, while others report 7,000-10,000 km; inspect the casing regularly.
Owner wet reports conflict: one found it better than a GP5000 in the wet, others found it very slippery once wet. No independent lab test found.
Mount in the direction of the rotation arrow, which some owners say is opposite to Continental's.
The official store price is CNY 268 per listing option; whether an option is one tire or a pair is not stated.
